title_sq: Apartament 2+1 per Shitje tek Kopshti Botanik!
description_sq:
hesim apartament te tipologjise 2+1 tek kopshti botanik prane Xhamise.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 3 te nje pallati te ri.
Siperfaqe neto 94 m2 si dhe ajo bruto 104 m2.
Organizohet ne nje dhome ndenjeje/kuzhina, 2 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete dhe 2 ballkone.
Apartamenti ka nje planimetri shume te rregullt dhe hapesira te konsiderueshme nje jetese komode per familjare te cilet duan komoditet.
Post Parkimi ne kosto ekstra.
Prona ofrohet e mobiluar.
title_en: 2+1 apartment for sale in the Botanical Garden!
description_en: We rent a 2+1 apartment in the botanical garden near Jamisa. The apartment is located on the 3rd floor of a new building. Net area 94 m2 and gross area 104 m2. It is organized in a living room/kitchen, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and 2 balconies. The apartment has a very regular layout and considerable spaces for a comfortable living for families who want comfort. Post Parking at extra cost. The property is offered furnished.
